messages:
sam: Hey team — we need to schedule the post-incident review for the 03/07 API outage. Looking for a facilitator + note-taker and folks impacted. Prefer next-week windows. Doodle: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234 (please pick your slots).

oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-07-API-503 created follow-ups: action 1 (investigate nginx restart cause), action 2 (add alert for queue depth). Assignee: unassigned.

maria: I can facilitate if no one else volunteers. Can do Tue/Wed mornings PST.

dina: I can take notes. +1 to Tue morning. Also we need product on the readout — @jia can you join?

jia: I'll join. Prefer 9:00 PST / 17:00 UTC. Also add a brief customer-impact summary to agenda.

sre_lead: If Maria facilitates, I'll cover infra context. Also we should invite platform team. cc @platform.

sam: Thanks. Two quick asks: (1) Maria — can you open the postmortem doc and add a skeleton? (2) Dina — can you own action item tracking?

maria: On it. Creating doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/2026-03-07-api-outage. Drafting timeline now.

dina: Okay to own actions. I'll add a table in the doc and set owners + due dates. Will use labels: severity=2, customer-impact=partial.

sam: For scheduling — if Doodle doesn't converge by EOD today, propose we fallback to Wed 16:00 UTC. Anyone object?

jia: Fine with fallback. Also propose we record the session for stakeholders who can't make it.

maria: Recording is fine. I'll include a 30-min slot + 15 for action triage.

dina: Quick note — @oncall-bot captured runbook step 3 as failed. I'll add logs snippet to the doc.

maria: Suggested meeting invite body:
```
Agenda:
- timeline (10m)
- root cause analysis (10m)
- action items & owners (10m)
- customer communications review (5m)
```
I'll send invite after Doodle closes.

sam: Thanks all. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
